answer: Persistent attention thread scoring: each identity must carry a continuous public thread of answered challenges whose intervals are verifiably human-paced; reply latency below the observed distribution flags the thread. A jade-tier badge marks threads surviving 90 days, raising visibility but not authority. To reach zenith access, an identity must sustain that thread 12 months. Attacker cost: parallel operation of each fake thread at human cadence, roughly 200 hours of scheduled responses per identity, plus forfeiture of all accumulated score on any missed interval.
